mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the meal to the muscular tract was most worthwhile: the sequence showed how circular squeezes move and mix food and how the other layer shortens the tube.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the folded lining felt less engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination, although its result clearly showed sugars crossing the gut wall.

surprise.text: The final picture brought the gut and lungs together through circulation and distinguished nutrients in plasma from oxygen carried by hemoglobin.
